### **Events:**

### **CSS Properties:**
 - **--pg-rem** - Base unit for every size (default 10px; 1rem follows the page font size) _(default: undefined)_
- **--pg-bg** - Component surface _(default: undefined)_
- **--pg-text-color-1** - Label text _(default: undefined)_
- **--pg-border-color** - Button border _(default: undefined)_
- **--pg-accent-color** - Active state fill, focus outline _(default: undefined)_
- **--pg-text-color-on-accent** - Label text in the active state _(default: undefined)_
- **--pg-hover-bg** - Hover background _(default: undefined)_
- **--pg-font-family** - Font family _(default: undefined)_
- **--pg-font-size-base** - Font size _(default: undefined)_
- **--pg-root-border-radius** - Corner radius _(default: undefined)_
- **--pg-root-min-height** - Minimum height _(default: undefined)_
- **--pg-root-padding-block** - Vertical padding _(default: undefined)_
- **--pg-root-padding-inline** - Horizontal padding _(default: undefined)_

attributes.name: active
attributes.description: Whether the component is in its active (pressed) state. Toggled by clicking; fires `change`.
